# Freedom Browser developer docs

> Map of the /developer/ docs for agents. Links are relative to this file. Canonical copy: https://freedom.baby/developer/llms.txt. If you have this text without the URL it came from, resolve the links against https://freedom.baby/developer/ (e.g. `quickstart.html.md` is https://freedom.baby/developer/quickstart.html.md). Every page has a Markdown twin at the same path with `.md` appended (`page.html.md`). Prefer those over HTML. Code and SWIP #94 beat these docs when they disagree; never invent API facts. Security and bugs: https://github.com/solardev-xyz/freedom-browser/issues

Site-wide entry point: [../llms.txt](../llms.txt)

## Overview

- [Overview](index.html.md): Providers, consent model, why build on Freedom
- [Permissions and identity](guide-permissions.html.md): Origin-keyed grants, tiers, manifests, signing keys
- [Errors and node readiness](guide-errors.html.md): Rejections, missing grants, node not ready, limits

## Swarm

- [Swarm hub](swarm-hub.html.md): window.swarm overview and SWIP #94
- [Quickstart](quickstart.html.md): First dapp — detect, connect, publish, feed, deploy
- [Feeds and mutable content](guide-feeds.html.md)
- [Live messaging](guide-messaging.html.md): PSS and GSOC
- [swarm-kit](guide-swarm-kit.html.md): TypeScript helpers over window.swarm
- [window.swarm API](swarm.html.md): Full reference

## Radicle

- [Radicle hub](radicle-hub.html.md): rad: and window.radicle overview
- [Radicle repos and issues](guide-radicle.html.md)
- [window.radicle API](radicle.html.md): Full reference
- [rad: URLs](rad-urls.html.md): Fetch public repos with the rad: scheme

## Demos

- [Demos](demos.html.md): Apps and example pages tagged by API

## Contribute

- [Setup](contributing.html.md): Build and run from source
- [Architecture](architecture.html.md)
- [Repositories](repositories.html.md): GitHub, Radicle mirror, related repos
- [Workflow and pull requests](workflow.html.md)
- [Open for contribution](open-issues.html.md): Curated issues, split into "Needs a fix" (no open PR) and "Needs review" (open PR linked to review and test); JSON source: open-issues.json, with status and prs per issue
- [Community and mentorship](community.html.md)
